test_title: PYST 15: SSC MTS 2024 - English Language and Comprehension (Held On 15 Oct, 2024 - Shift 1)
subject: english
question:
Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.

________ we gave them was some homemade ice cream.
solution:
The correct answer is '**What**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word "**What**" correctly introduces the noun clause that serves as the subject of the sentence.
 
• This construction conveys that the thing given to "them" was homemade ice cream.
 
• **Options 1, 2**, and 3 do not fit this context and are grammatically incorrect here.

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 4**.

 

**Complete Sentence:** *"What we gave them was some homemade ice cream."*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 1: "Which"** is incorrect because it typically introduces a relative clause, not a noun clause.
 
• **Option 2: "When"** is incorrect because it refers to time, which is not relevant in this context.
 
• **Option 3: "While"** is incorrect because it indicates a period of time, which also doesn't fit the context.
